tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Primary background: desktop, top bar, terminal, lock screen. OLED black in dark, off-white paper in light. Also the text colour on a text-display fill.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Elevated surfaces on black: windows, cards, notifications, dock, launcher.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Second elevation inside a surface: selected row, dropdown, popover.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: row dividers, empty progress segments, title-bar rule. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-visible
tokens.usage: Intentional outlines: windows, secondary buttons, tags, inputs, toggle track (off), dot grid.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls, placeholders, empty workspaces, decorative marks on black and surface. Below 4.5:1 by design (4.0:1 dark, 2.6:1 light): never for text a person must read.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, metadata on black, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body text and values on black, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: text-display
tokens.usage: The one hero value or headline per screen on black and surface; fill of primary buttons, active segments and on-toggles (with black text); focus ring.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Two jobs. Interrupt: critical notification, error, over-limit data, destructive outline; at most one per screen, always with words beside it. Live marker: caret, clock colon, today, current workspace, focused-app dot, leading progress segment, unread dot; a mark, never text, at most one per part. As a mark or border on black, surface and text-display (3:1+); as text only at 24px and above in dark (4.1:1 on black).

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Tint behind an accent state when a mark alone is not enough. Carries no text contrast on its own; text on it stays text-primary.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and marks on an accent fill: today's date in the calendar, a destructive button on hover. White in both themes (4.9:1 on accent).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Data in range, connected, completed: on the value or the bar, on black and surface. In light it is 3.0:1 on black: bars, dots and 24px+ text only, with the reading in text-primary.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Data needing attention, pending, degraded: on the value or the bar, on black and surface. In light it is 2.0:1 on black: bars and dots only, always beside a word or number in text-primary.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Errors share the accent: an error is the accent moment. Same grounds and limits as accent.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral informational status on black and surface.

tokens.name: interactive
tokens.usage: Inline links and tappable values in running text on black and surface. Never buttons. Light value is 3.7:1 on black: underline links there.

tokens.name: ansi-red
tokens.usage: Terminal colour 1 and 9 on black.

tokens.name: ansi-green
tokens.usage: Terminal colour 2 and 10 on black; light value darkened to read as text.

tokens.name: ansi-yellow
tokens.usage: Terminal colour 3 and 11 on black; light value darkened to read as text.

tokens.name: ansi-blue
tokens.usage: Terminal colour 4 and 12 on black; light value darkened to read as text.

tokens.name: ansi-magenta
tokens.usage: Terminal colour 5 and 13 on black. Terminal only.

tokens.name: ansi-cyan
tokens.usage: Terminal colour 6 and 14 on black. Terminal only.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Lock-screen clock, boot percentage. One per screen.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Page titles, the wordmark. Smallest size Doto may be set.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings in settings and apps.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Updates install the next time you restart.
styles.usage: Body text, list content, notification titles.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary body, notification text, menu items.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, inline status text, tags, footnotes.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Instrument labels, top bar, window titles, units. Always ALL CAPS in text-secondary.

tokens.name: space-2xs
tokens.usage: Optical adjustments; gap between progress segments.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label and number-to-unit gaps.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Inside components; window gaps in a tiling layout.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Standard padding; gap between items in a group; screen-edge gap.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Window and widget padding; group separation.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Section margins; lock-screen inset.

tokens.name: space-2xl
tokens.usage: Major section breaks.

tokens.name: space-3xl
tokens.usage: Page-level vertical rhythm.

tokens.name: space-4xl
tokens.usage: Breathing room around a hero; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-technical
tokens.usage: Technical tags, key caps.

tokens.name: radius-compact
tokens.usage: Menus, dropdowns, bordered inputs.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Windows, notifications, quick-settings tiles.

tokens.name: radius-widget
tokens.usage: Widgets, launcher, popovers. The largest corner in the system.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, tags, toggles, segmented controls, dock.

tokens.name: bar-height
tokens.usage: Top bar height.

tokens.name: titlebar-height
tokens.usage: Window title bar height.

tokens.name: control-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of buttons, list items and dock slots.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Icon box; live area is 20px.

tokens.name: dot-pitch
tokens.usage: Dot-grid spacing.
